answer: Problem: disposable identities flood panels before peers can check lineage. Mechanism: each newcomer banks a cooled ember stake equal to 0.35% of the prior tip median, then walks three terrace windows of 42 minutes; full transfer unlocks only after two peers post a distinct-neighborhood signal attest at join-depth >=2. Cost: ~126 minutes lock plus two peer exposures. Verification: panel rejects shared invite parents within depth 3. Failure: if either signal reverses, burn the ember and restart the terrace clock.
